Commentary.Commentary: The Indian top order gave them a good start and were 154/1 at one stage. After that, the Kiwis made a strong comeback, running through the Indian middle order and restricting the further damage and would be happy with their overall bowling performance. Kohli too would be pleased with this total and would hope his bowlers work their magic on the visitors. Let's see how the Black caps go about their batting. Stay tuned...

Neil Wagner came into attack then and it only took him 6 balls to claim the wicket of Umesh Yadav and finish the Indian innings.

The players are out in the middle. The sun is shining bright and let's hope the rain stays away today. RAVINDRA JADEJA and UMESH YADAV will take their place in the centre. MITCHELL SANTNER will start the proceedings first up for the Black Caps.

The pitch has started to show signs of breaking up a bit and the Kiwi spinners extracted a good amount of turn. It is a good omen for the Indian spinners and it will be enthralling to witness how the visiting side counter them. Let's hope rain doesn't play spoilsport on what promises to be a riveting day of Test cricket.

Hello and a warm welcome for the 2nd Day of the first Test between India and New Zealand. We witnessed an exciting contest on day 1 between bat and ball as 291 runs were scored and 9 wickets fell. India slumped from 154/1 to 291/9 and wasted a brilliant platform set by Lokesh Rahul, Murali Vijay and Cheteshwar Pujara. 291 still seems to be a competitive first innings total and whatever India add to their overnight total would be an added bonus.
... DAY 2, SESSION 1 ...

Umesh Yadav and Ravindra Jadeja are still out in the middle and will look to add as much as possible to the total. The Black Caps would look to clinch the last wicket early on and later fight it out in the middle with the bat as they have an uphill task of facing the Indian spinners. Join us tomorrow at 0930 IST for the coverage of Day 2! Till then, take good care of yourself!

Earlier in the day, Cheteshwar Pujara and Murali Vijay completed their respective half centuries. Trent Boult and Mitchell Santner were the most successful bowlers for the Kiwis, picking up 3 wickets each. Other bowlers didn't bowl badly either and were rewarded with one wicket apiece. They bowled really well to come back strongly after just picking up 1 wicket at lunch.

After that, Rohit Sharma along with Ravichandran Ashwin stitched up a 52-run partnership for the 6th wicket. Soon after Sharma fell cheaply to Santner. Trent Boult finally found his rhythm and drilled through the Indian tail in a hurry.

A lot was expected out of Virat Kohli but he fell to the short ball ploy employed by Neil Wagner for a meager innings of 9 runs. Wagner proved his old workhorse ethics and hustled in with intensity through every ball and gave it his all. He is certainly a captain's dream to have in the side. Ish Sodhi struck just at the stroke of tea and sent the well set Murali Vijay packing. The Kiwis have paved their way back into the match. Will they continue to make a dent in the Indian batting line-up or will the pair of Rahane and Sharma steady the ship for India? Join us for the post-tea session to find out!

Mitchell Santner is the only one who has looked threatening and varied his pace as well as his lines and lengths. Since then, Murali Vijay and Cheteshwar Pujara have creamed the Kiwi spinners and India have sailed to 105/1 at the end of 31 overs. A tough challenge awaits the visiting side and it will be exciting to see how they cope up with the lack of help from the pitch and adjust accordingly. India are in control at the moment and they would look forward to press forward with authority. Join us for the post lunch session which promises to be an enticing one!

INDIA playing XI - Murali Vijay, Lokesh Rahul, Cheteshwar Pujara, Virat Kohli(c), Ajinkya Rahane, Rohit Sharma, Ravichandran Ashwin, Wriddhiman Saha(wk), Ravindra Jadeja, Mohammed Shami, Umesh Yadav

New Zealand skipper, Kane Williamson says it would have been nice to win the toss and would have batted first as well as he reckons it is a dry surface. He also feels that he has had a good practice session as well and his young side is looking forward for the contest. He is playing a combination of 6 batsmen and 5 bowlers with three spinners and two quicks in Trent Boult and Neil Wagner.

Indian skipper, Virat Kohli thinks it's a good wicket and will bat first. His team had a good practice session in the past 3-4 days. He says that he is grateful and honoured to be captaining his team on the historic occasion of India's 500th Test match. He is playing a bowling combination consisting of two quicks, two spinners and two part-time spinners.
TOSS - Virat Kohli flips the coin, Kane Williamson calls it wrong. India wins the toss and elect to bat first.

The visitors, the Kiwis have shown in the recent times that they play spin well and would look to prove it on the rank turners in India. They have flourished well under the captaincy of Kane Williamson and will hope to continue their progress and register their first ever Test series win in India. We are expecting showers over the course of 5 days. Hope it stays away as we are set for an enthralling contest between these two young sides led by two young captains. Stay tuned for the team news and the Toss!

A very warm welcome to all of you. New Zealand's visit will get underway today with a Test match which will take place at Green Park in Kanpur. It's an historic occasion for India as they are playing their 500th Test match. India are undefeated in their last ten outings in the Tests and would look to stretch this record. Last time when they played on the home soil, they outclassed the visiting team. Virat Kohli would expect nothing less form his team this time around too.
